firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently petted an alpaca goes first and takes the alpaca miniature.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise. The rulebook jokingly says that if no one has petted an alpaca, players should go pet one immediately; it gives no practical alternate starter.
